decisions.reason: As a 2023 line extension that remained on the site in 2024, it still preserves option value, though its more limited prominence and possible overlap with newer laser offerings raise some pruning risk.
This close-to-core printer kept its own product page across 2023 and 2024, suggesting acceptable traction and low enough carrying cost to keep the option open.
Like the thermal inkjet model, this piezo inkjet printer stayed prominently listed over two years, so uncertainty has not resolved negatively enough to justify withdrawal.
As a 2024 flagship-direction product shown on the home page and tightly aligned with the firm's Industry 4.0 trajectory, management would be very unlikely to drop it so soon.
This newly launched laser cabin fits the firm's established laser portfolio and is recent enough that the firm is likely to retain it while market feedback continues to develop.
Although more niche, it builds on the core offer and its trade-fair award is a positive signal, so the firm would likely continue backing it rather than close the option early.
